title: feat(editor): alt-drag the text being edited to duplicate it
body:
- Alt-dragging the text being edited ends the editing and duplicates the text (or its container), as alt-dragging it on the canvas does
  - the press always moves what was edited — never a resize handle, or an arrow's point, midpoint or label beneath the editor
  - on drop, the duplicate is edited with all of its text selected (only a list item's text, as in #12189)
- Fix: adding an arrow label by double-click left the midpoint highlighted, and hovering near it re-highlighted it while editing
- Fix: hovering from an arrow's midpoint straight onto an endpoint lost the endpoint highlight (batched hover updates overwrote each other)

Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh)
